Depth_Project_Jay_Damask.png.title: Depth Project
Depth_Project_Jay_Damask.png.body: This is a project I made in school on a tablet for a project. We had to explore depth with value, and instead of creating a simple mountainscape, I opted to draw individually the many buildings that make up a city.

InkDemonMatcap.PNG.title: Ink Demon Matcap
InkDemonMatcap.PNG.body: A 3D model of The Ink Demon from the Bendy series. Hard surface modeled in full, no sculpting.

InkDemonWireframe.PNG.title: Ink Demon Wireframe
InkDemonWireframe.PNG.body: A wireframe view of the 3d model, highlighting the clean topology.

Nemi.png.title: The Nemesis
Nemi.png.body: An illustration of The Nemesis from Resident Evil 3. My first experience using digital coloring tools on procreate. Experimented with various brushes, like grunge and fire.

annotated-HW7F-ALTERED.png.title: Lockdown!
annotated-HW7F-ALTERED.png.body: This is a comic I made for my summer course that depicts a scary lockdown situation we had at my high school. I depicted the terror I felt in the moment in the 2nd panel, petrified at the thought of there being a shooter. Ultimately we were let out of school and nothing of note happened, but the entire school resonated with fear for those quiet 20 minutes.

annotated-HW8F2-ALTERED.png.title: Power Nap
annotated-HW8F2-ALTERED.png.body: This is another comic that I made for my summer course at Harvard, instead focusing on my issue with sleeping in. I use bubble panels to indicate that the first half of the comic is simply a dream, while the rest actually happens.

annotated-HW9F-ALTERED.png.title: CODE RED
annotated-HW9F-ALTERED.png.body: This is the last comic I made during my summer course at Harvard, regarding climate change and the future of the Earth. Smoke shrouds the comic to imply gradual decay throughout the panels.
